description: Purchase a catalog item and place it at (x,y,level) facing dir. Transaction is verified server-side: price debited via GlobalLink.PerformTransaction, then Verified=true, then re-applied on the lot's VM. Prerequisite: you must be the lot owner (handler-side gate via VMTSOLotState.OwnerID; server-side gate via PlatformState.Validator.GetPurchaseMode returning >= BuildBuyRoommate). Lot must not be full. Cost: the catalog price (with build-mode discount applied by server) from your budget; refunded by the server if placement fails. Effect: a new object appears in nearby_objects at (x,y,level); your balance (query-self.balance) drops by the net price. Mode=Donate (visitor-placed donation) reduces net cost to 1/3 of Normal but requires CanPlaceNewDonatedObject permission. OQ-8 note: there is no 'enter build mode' PDU — gating is per-command inside VMNetBuyObjectCmd.Verify; if you lack permission the command is silently dropped (no error, no effect). Wire: VMNetBuyObjectCmd on the lot Aries socket.
